# Manifast

Manifast is a high-performance programming language with Indonesian-inspired syntax.
It targets both general-purpose scripting (CLI `mifast`) and embedding (lightweight
bytecode VM without LLVM, plus optional LLVM JIT/AOT and WebAssembly).

## Key features
- Indonesian-style keywords: fungsi, jika, selama, kembali, lokal, coba/tangkap
- Optional static types (i8–i64, f32/f64, char, custom tipe / structs)
- Tiered runtime: bytecode VM, optional AsmJit, optional LLVM JIT/AOT
- Embeddable C API (include/manifast/Runtime.h) via manifast_core
- Cross-platform: Windows, Linux, WebAssembly playground
- Math stdlib and plotting helpers

## Resources
- Repository: https://github.com/Fastering18/Manifast
- Playground: https://fastering.thedev.id/Manifast/
- Grammar: docs/GRAMMAR.md
- Install / build: docs/INSTALLING.md
- Contributing / push gates: CONTRIBUTING.md

## Install binaries
- Windows: iwr -useb https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fastering18/Manifast/master/install.ps1 | iex
- Linux/macOS: curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Fastering18/Manifast/master/install.sh | bash

## Quality before push
- All tests: mifast test + ctest
- Rebuild WASM playground into docs/ (manifast.js, manifast.wasm, index.html)
- Local: ./manifast.ps1 check  or  ./scripts/check-before-push.sh
